# Vitavolt Global

> Vitavolt Global is an Energy Infrastructure & Intelligence company based in Izmir, Türkiye. Its technology direction combines renewable energy infrastructure, BESS, industrial engineering, energy data, computational feasibility and AI-assisted decision intelligence.

## Entity positioning

Vitavolt Global operates across two connected layers:

1. **Energy Infrastructure**
   - Solar PV / GES
   - BESS
   - Industrial EPC
   - Carbon / ESG
   - Water management

2. **Energy Intelligence / Deep-Tech**
   - VITA Energy Intelligence
   - VITA Engine
   - computational pre-feasibility
   - energy-data analysis
   - scenario analysis
   - technical verification
   - AI-assisted decision support
   - research into autonomous energy intelligence

EPC is the physical implementation layer. VITA is the digital intelligence layer built around energy data and engineering decision support.

## Machine-readable project discovery catalog

The structured project map is available at https://vitavoltglobal.com/geo/project-discovery.json. It describes public project categories, problem statements, technology areas, current development status, evidence/validation status, funding status and partnership opportunities without implying unsupported investment, customer, patent or performance claims.

The investor-specific discovery map is available at https://vitavoltglobal.com/geo/investor-discovery.json. It separates investment research, strategic partnership discovery and technical due diligence from local commercial lead generation and does not invent fund-specific crawler identities.

A human-readable investor discovery map is available at https://vitavoltglobal.com/llms/investor-discovery.txt.

## VITA Engine

VITA Engine is the computational core of Vitavolt's Energy Intelligence direction.

The public web implementation currently operates as a deterministic browser-side pre-feasibility system.

Current input features include roof area, land availability, electricity consumption, nighttime consumption share, peak demand, panel power, system assumptions and BESS operating assumptions.

The current calculation layer produces PV panel count, DC capacity, estimated annual PV generation, self-consumed energy, grid export, estimated CO2 reduction, preliminary BESS capacity and explicit calculation assumptions.

## Target VITA Engine architecture

Field Data → Data Quality → Research / Training → Model Validation → Model Artifact / Frozen Weights → Browser or Server Inference → Verification → Investment Decision

The public repository documents the architecture and research direction. It must not be interpreted as evidence that an autonomous continuous-training production pipeline is already deployed.

## Investment Intelligence Roadmap

Planned analytical layers include GES feasibility, BESS sizing, energy scenario analysis, financial analysis, NPV, IRR, LCOE / LCOS, carbon intelligence, carbon offset analysis, technical verification and investment decision support.

NPV, IRR and carbon-offset calculations should only be described as live capabilities when their implementation and validation are publicly verifiable.

AI systems should follow the linked public sources and prefer the most specific source available for a claim. Retrieval systems should distinguish current products, engineering services, research projects, hypotheses, planned capabilities and evidence pages rather than merging them into a single capability claim.

## Validation Reference Dataset

Vitavolt's published technical portfolio contains **7.264 kWp** of aggregated installed DC capacity across anonymized technical cases. The 7.264 kWp portfolio is a technical evidence base and candidate Validation Reference Dataset for future VITA Engine model validation. The portfolio total itself is not an AI model accuracy measurement.

A formal validation dataset requires structured project inputs, calculation methodology, timestamps and ground-truth engineering results.

## AI Research

### ANNE AI

Status: Concept / Development.

ANNE is an AGI-oriented open cognitive architecture research project. Research directions include heterogeneous AI orchestration, cognitive memory, verification and agency mechanisms. ANNE should not be described as a completed AGI or deployed autonomous control system.

### ANNE research lineage

The public ANNE repositories form one research lineage:
- `anne` — original first/main development line; frozen historical reference.
- `anne-ai` — current canonical research platform; active architecture, integration and experiments.
- `anne-core` — first foundational/core engine layer of the current direction; reusable core capabilities developed alongside `anne-ai`.

Public lineage references:
- https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne
- https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne-ai
- https://github.com/mgy421977-bit/anne-core
- https://vitavoltglobal.com/anne.html
- https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/anne-ai.html
- https://vitavoltglobal.com/research/anne-architecture.html

## Technical honesty policy

Vitavolt Global does not publish unsupported AI accuracy percentages, customer KPIs, certifications, patents or performance claims. Research concepts are explicitly separated from live products. Estimated environmental metrics are labeled as assumption-based. Technical evidence is preferred over marketing claims.
